RaMP multi-database ORA returned an FDR of 1.74e-10 with fold-enrichment of 900-fold (REACT:R-HSA-73621 Pyrimidine catabolism; 4 hits / 40 pathway members). MetaboAnalystR PSEA against the KEGG library confirmed the same four metabolites in KEGG:hsa00240 (p = 4.47e-06). The m/z-direct mummichog algorithm independently identified the same KEGG pyrimidine metabolism module as rank-1 (p = 3.36e-04), with a 13/14 pathway overlap including two additional deoxyribose-phosphate intermediates (CDP and 2-deoxy-α-D-ribose 1-phosphate) that are structurally proximal to the input set. Cross-paradigm consensus is absolute: pyrimidine catabolism and the de novo/ salvage synthetic branch are simultaneously perturbed. The five metabolites not enriched (spironolactone, CDP, deoxyribose 1-P, 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid, methionine sulfoxide) are either pharmacological effect markers (spironolactone), deoxyribose-handling intermediates that mummichog maps to the same network cluster, or biologically peripheral to the core pyrimidine signal. The biological story is a wholesale disruption of uracil-to-β-alanine catabolic flux, consistent with dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase inhibition or a nucleoside-analogue treatment effect.
